svg.title: Darkroom — exploded view
svg.desc: The loaded sled leaves through the open front; the diffuser lifts off its rails. Drawn from cad/darkroom.scad; not to scale.

g.text: The loaded sled leaves through the open front; the diffuser lifts off its rails.
front plate + floor + rails + rear bulkhead,
low-head, flush; heads only in CAD

Concept geometry from cad/darkroom.scad (v0.4); not a fabrication drawing or a confirmed build. The microSD reader is a placeholder board; display and PiSugar fit,
